findings.summary: step publishes an obsolete local-modal readiness result after request reenters a newer local modal
findings.cause: step ignores request rejection and captures the new epoch after reentrant native setter/onIntent work, then calls readiness using its old intent argument; localFrame truthiness publishes without a fresh intent equality check.
findings.reproduction: Published battle base; ready(deck)=true, ready(potion)=false; SetSizeDelta during step(deck) reenters request(potion). Actual: intent=potionPanel, published=deckPanel, state=visible, cover=false.
findings.expected: Keep current unready potion request covered; old outer step must return false and must not publish old readiness.
findings.fix: After request, require passed intent still matches current self.intent before consulting readiness; retain epoch/readiness callback guards. Add step entry to the native setter reentrancy matrix, including reentry to a different same-base local modal.
